newsitem.title: USA: Ekco stock tumbles sees loss for quarter, year.
newsitem.headline: Ekco stock tumbles sees loss for quarter, year.

text.p: The stock of Ekco Group Inc. lost nearly 24 percent of its value Wednesday after the housewares maker warned that it will report a loss for both the third quarter and the year.
Ekco was down $1.125 to $3.625 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

The company, which manufacturers kitchenware, plastic storage products, brooms, brushes and mops, said it expects to post a loss of $22 million, or $1.18 a share, in the third quarter and a loss for the year of $29 million, or $1.53 a share.
The Nashua, N.H.-based company blamed the downturn on special charges and lower-than-expected sales.

Ekco said its plastics business has been under severe price and cost pressures for the past several years. It said it has not been able to recover higher resin costs through increased prices and has been forced to offer larger discounts on many products in order to remain competitive in the marketplace.
In last year's third quarter, Ekco earned 23 cents a share on revenues of $83 million and for all of 1995, it earned 40 cents a share on revenues of $278 million.
Ekco expects to announce its latest results during the week of Oct. 21.
The company also said its board of directors suspended the payment of a quarterly dividend and does not anticipate paying cash dividends for the foreseeable future.
